messages:
Lila Patel: Hey team — first day! Trying to find the Notion onboarding docs and the new-hire checklist but I don't have edit access to the templates. Where do they live and who can grant access? Thanks :wave:
OnboardingBot: Welcome Lila! Quick links: https://redwood.notion.so/Redwood-Handbook-xxxxx. Templates live under 'Shared Templates / Onboarding'. By default most templates are view-only for new hires.
Samir Khan: Welcome! Docs live under Redwood > Handbook > Team > New hires. Templates folder: Redwood > Shared Templates > Onboarding. I can add you to the redwood-editors group. Do you want edit or comment access?
Lila Patel: Edit please — I need to update my checklist with setup steps I already did.
Jin Park: Added Lila to redwood-editors — you should get an invite email from Notion in a few minutes. If you don't see it, check spam or ping me here.
Lila Patel: Got it, invite came through, I can edit now. Quick Q: is there a preferred template for 'first week goals' or just the checklist?
Samir Khan: Use 'First Week Plan (Eng)' if you're on Eng. It has a goals section + checklist for common infra access. Engineering also uses the 'Dev Onboarding' template for environment setup. Best practice: copy the template to your personal workspace and then share the page with your manager and buddy.
Diego Ramos: Heads up for editing canonical docs: we follow a docs-review process. If you edit anything under Handbook root that should be reviewed, add the tag @docs-review or drop the 'Review: Onboarding' label so Docs team can audit before we publish. Quick snippet/process: 
```
1) Copy template -> create page in Handbook draft folder
2) Make edits, add @docs-review mention
3) Docs team reviews and we move to canonical page
```
Lila Patel: Perfect. Also — where are access request logs? I want to check permissions for contractors who will shadow next week.
Samir Khan: Notion logs are limited; for audit-grade records use the Admin Console or ask Kate (Notion admin). If you need a quick lookup I can pull the access list and share it.
Lila Patel: :thumbsup: Thanks. One more: are there required training modules to add to the checklist (security, data handling, etc)?
OnboardingBot: Mandatory trainings: Security Basics, Data Hygiene, Internal Code of Conduct. Add them using the template section 'Mandatory Training'. Links: https://learning.redwood/sec and https://learning.redwood/data
Lila Patel: Done — copied the template, filled out first-week goals, added trainings, and shared with Samir & Jin for review. Closing this thread, thanks everyone :pray:
